findings.evidence: ImDilation.lean:335 `theorem _root_.TopologicalSpace.Opens.closure_upperHalf_subset_reflectionCore {Ω W : Opens ℂ} (hWΩ : closure (W : Set ℂ) ⊆ Ω) : closure (W.upperHalf : Set ℂ) ⊆ Ω.reflectionCore`; the new helper's proof uses only `closure_minimal` and `inter_setOf_im_nonneg_subset_reflectionCore`.
findings.fix: Move it to `TauCeti/Analysis/Complex/ImDilation.lean` as a public lemma, e.g. `Opens.closure_inter_setOf_im_nonneg_subset_reflectionCore` (with the compactness half either a separate lemma or derived at the call site via `IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset`).
findings.issue: `isCompact_closure_inter_setOf_im_nonneg` is private but is general reflection-core geometry (closure of `U ∩ {0 ≤ im}` lies in `Ω.reflectionCore`), strictly generalising the public `Opens.closure_upperHalf_subset_reflectionCore` from open `W` with strict upper half to arbitrary `U` with the closed half-plane.

findings.evidence: Reflection.lean:115 `theorem planarReflection_of_nonneg (d : Fin k → ℝ) (g : ℂ → F) {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 ≤ z.im)`; the helper's statement mentions only `planarReflection`, `volume.restrict` and `{0 ≤ im}`.
findings.fix: Move it to `TauCeti/Analysis/Sobolev/Local/Reflection.lean` next to `planarReflection_of_nonneg` and make it public.
findings.issue: `planarReflection_ae_eq_inter_setOf_im_nonneg` is private but is the a.e. form of `planarReflection_of_nonneg`, independent of products and needed by every half-disc bound proved by reflection (including the deferred kp > 2 half-disc bounds).

summary: The new public theorems are an appropriate surface, but both private helpers are general reflection-core/reflection facts that do not depend on this file's subject and should be exported from their canonical homes.
